title: Exact and atLeast rules inside cells: exact pins every line at the rule (24pt lines, 10pt lines clipping 11pt glyphs), atLeast lays max(rule, natural) per line
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-28), pymupdf rules: exact 480 two-line row 48.48, exact 200 row 20.40, atLeast 400 row 40.56, plain Calibri 11 two-line row 27.36

cases.note: the cap keeps a taller run from growing the line; lead-top puts the baseline at 0.8 h (styles.css)
exact below the glyph height: Word clips, the cap stops the 11pt run box from re-growing the line
a direct atLeast must not cap its runs at an inherited style-level exact rule
